label: Helion Energy Valuation (Series G, Jun 2026)
deltaNote: June 4, 2026: $465M Series G led by Thrive Capital (Josh Kushner) with Alta Park, Lux Capital, Peak XV, SoftBank, Sam Altman. Valuation: $15.5B (up from $5.43B). Total capital: $1.5B. Orion commercial plant under construction in Malaga, WA for Microsoft 2028 delivery.

label: NIF Record Fusion Yield
deltaNote: Correction: NIF's confirmed record is 8.6 MJ yield (gain 4.13x) from a 2.08 MJ laser shot on April 7, 2025 — the facility's 8th ignition — per LLNL's official records page, superseding the previously tracked Feb 2024 figure of 5.2 MJ (gain 2.36x). EYC laser upgrade (2.2→2.6 MJ) cleared Critical Decision-1 on April 24, 2026; targets significantly higher yields when operational in the late 2020s.

label: ITER Assembly Progress
contestNote: ITER Baseline 2024 revised first plasma to 2033; assembly slowed by vacuum vessel dimensional defects and thermal shield stress corrosion cracks. On May 5, 2026, DG Barabaschi declared ITER is now on budget and on schedule — the first such declaration in project history. The 38th ITER Council meeting (Jun 25-26, 2026) reaffirmed Baseline 2024 is holding. On July 28, 2026 ITER installed the sixth of nine tokamak sector modules — two-thirds of the plasma chamber now in place, ~6 months ahead of schedule; the final module is targeted for mid-2027.

label: Total Private Fusion Capital Raised
source: Fusion Industry Association 2026 Global Fusion Industry Report + CFS Jul 30, 2026 raise
delta: +69% YoY per FIA (Jul 14); +$1B CFS round since (Jul 30)
deltaNote: FIA's 2026 annual report (Jul 14, 2026) put cumulative private fusion financing at $14.24B since 2021, after a record $4.48B raised in the past year — up 69% YoY. Commonwealth Fusion Systems then raised a further $1B on July 30, 2026 (not yet reflected in FIA's tally), pushing the sector total to roughly $15.2B+ and its own cumulative raise to $4B — ~30% of all private fusion investment globally, and the industry's first pension-fund-backed round. Two companies (General Fusion, TAE Technologies) are going public via Nasdaq in 2026.

label: KSTAR Plasma Duration Record
deltaNote: June 2, 2026: KSTAR sustained 100M°C plasma for 102 seconds — first tokamak to do so in a fully tungsten-walled configuration, validating the divertor upgrade completed in 2025. Still below the 300-second 2026 target, which KFE has not revised.

label: EAST Sustained Plasma Record
deltaNote: January 20, 2025 at 100M°C; longest sustained H-mode plasma in history

label: Active Private Fusion Companies
deltaNote: 25 in USA; 35 of 45 surveyed forecast commercially viable pilot plants by 2030–2035

label: ITER First Plasma Target
contestNote: Original target was 2025; revised to 2033 (first plasma) and 2039 (D-T burning plasma). Budget grew from ~€5B (2006) to €20B+ (2024).

label: CFS HTS Magnet Field Strength
delta: World record for large-scale HTS magnet
deltaNote: Achieved September 5, 2021 using 267 km of YBCO tape; enables compact SPARC tokamak design. SPARC ~75% complete; first plasma targeted 2027.

label: Fusion Grid Application
deltaNote: CFS filed the first-ever fusion energy company application to PJM Interconnection (the largest US wholesale electricity market, 65M+ customers) on April 28, 2026 — a landmark commercial milestone.

label: First Publicly Listed Fusion Company
deltaNote: General Fusion completed its SPAC merger with Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. III and began trading July 13, 2026 at $12.85/share — the first pure-play fusion company on public markets, ahead of TAE Technologies' pending Trump Media merger (targeting Q4 2026 close). ~$150M cash on hand funds Lawson program milestones through 2028; commercial plant now targeted for ~2035.

label: Proxima Fusion Funding Round
deltaNote: Munich stellarator developer Proxima Fusion raised €411M led by XTX Ventures and East X Ventures, with Google and RWE as strategic investors. Funds 'Alpha,' a net-energy stellarator demonstrator near Munich, built with Bavaria, Max Planck IPP, and RWE. FIA's 2026 report tallies Proxima's total raise at $518M.

label: Fuse Energy FAETON-X Neutron Yield (Peak)
source: Fuse Energy Technologies / POWER Magazine — August 10, 2026
contestNote: Company-reported result from a preprint (Research Square) not yet independently peer-reviewed. Fuse claims this is the highest publicly documented neutron yield by any private fusion company — about 40% more neutrons per megajoule than LLNL's MJOLNIR pulsed-power facility.
delta: First shot to record in 9 months

label: General Fusion LM26 Plasma Electron Temperature
deltaNote: Demonstrated by compressing a lithium-liner-confined plasma as part of General Fusion's first public-company business update. Long-term targets are 10 keV and the Lawson criterion for net fusion energy. Company entered public markets with ~$150M cash, funding LM26 milestones through 2028.

label: Inertia/LLNL Fusion Fuel Layer Formation Time
source: Inertia Enterprises / Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory — August 25, 2026
deltaNote: Manufacturing breakthrough cuts formation time for the cryogenic deuterium-tritium 'ice' fuel layer inside inertial confinement targets, versus multiple days required at NIF. Simulations show negligible fusion-performance cost given Inertia's planned 10 MJ laser is less sensitive to layer imperfections than NIF's 2 MJ system.
